verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a self-hostable AI workspace like AnythingLLM, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one. The pack covers API access, Docker self-hosting, the desktop app, agent skills and MCP compatibility, none of which is a first-party command-line interface. API access and Docker are adjacent building blocks or host tooling, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
